visualCharacteristics.description: Collapsible items with plus/minus toggles and divider lines
visualCharacteristics.source: Interactive collapsible items (Mission, Vision, Sustainability) with + toggles and divider lines. | Interactive collapsible items with + toggles; same visual pattern as s6-q3, so the same variant is reused.

contentPattern.structure: Cell 1: item title. Cell 2: body content
rows: one row per item (3 in s6, 4 in s8)

reuseGuidance: Use wherever a plus-toggle accordion is needed; inherits text color from the section (works on dark and light sections).
